docs.title: Documentation
docs.heading: User Guide & Documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using the FinAI Agent system
docs.gsIntro: Welcome to FinAI Agent! This comprehensive platform uses advanced AI to analyze financial statements and provide credit risk assessments. Follow this guide to get started quickly.
docs.gsStep1_1: Log in with your credentials provided by your administrator
docs.gsStep1_2: Select your preferred language (English/Spanish) from the top navigation
docs.gsStep1_3: Review your profile settings and update as needed
docs.gsStep2Desc: All features are protected and require authentication. Your access level (Admin/User) determines which features you can use. Admins have full access including user management.
docs.tip1Desc: Switch between English and Spanish anytime using the language selector
docs.tip2Desc: Your analysis results are automatically saved and accessible from the Reports page
docs.uploadIntro: Upload financial statements to generate comprehensive credit analysis reports. The system accepts both single consolidated files and split financial documents.
docs.uploadMethod1Step1: Navigate to 'Upload Data' from the sidebar
docs.uploadMethod1Step2: Drag and drop your Excel or PDF file, or click to browse
docs.uploadMethod1Step4: Click 'Analyze Document' and wait for processing
docs.uploadMethod2Step1: Use the split upload option if you have separate documents
docs.uploadMethod2Step2: Upload Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss, and Cash Flow statements separately
docs.uploadMethod2Step3: The system will merge and analyze all documents
docs.uploadImportantDesc: Ensure your financial statements cover at least 3 years of data for accurate analysis. Supported formats: .xlsx, .xls, .pdf
docs.analysisIntro: Once your document is processed, you'll see a comprehensive analysis page with multiple components providing insights into the company's financial health.
docs.analysisComp1Desc: Key ratios including Current Ratio, ROE, ROA, Debt-to-Assets, Profit Margin, and Interest Coverage. Each indicator shows the calculated value and interpretation.
docs.analysisComp2Desc: AI-generated assessment of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats based on financial performance and industry context.
docs.analysisComp3Desc: Visual representation of key metrics through bar and pie charts for easy trend identification.
docs.analysisComp4Desc: Final credit decision (Approve, Approve with Conditions, Reject) along with credit category (A-E) and detailed justification.
docs.reportsIntro: The Reports page displays all your historical analyses in a searchable, filterable table. You can review past assessments, track trends, and export data.
docs.reportsViewDesc: Click any row to view the full analysis report with all indicators, SWOT, and recommendations
docs.reportsSearchDesc: Use the search bar to find specific companies or filter by credit grade (A-E)
docs.reportsExportDesc: Export analysis datasets for external reporting or archival (feature available in header)
docs.usersAdminOnly: User Management is only available to administrators. If you don't see this option, contact your admin for access.
docs.usersCreateDesc: Add new team members with email, name, password, and role assignment (Admin/User)
docs.usersEditDesc: Update user details including name, email, and role from the actions menu
docs.usersToggleDesc: Temporarily disable user access without deleting the account
docs.usersDeleteDesc: Permanently remove a user from the system (use with caution)
docs.faqIntro: Common questions and answers about using FinAI Agent.
docs.faq1Q: What file formats are supported for upload?
docs.faq1A: The system accepts Excel files (.xlsx, .xls) and PDF documents. For best results, use Excel files with clearly labeled financial statements covering 3+ years.
docs.faq2A: Analysis typically completes in 30-60 seconds depending on document complexity. You'll see a loading indicator during processing.
docs.faq3Q: Can I re-analyze the same company with updated data?
docs.faq3A: Yes! Simply upload the new financial statements. The system will create a new analysis report while keeping historical records accessible.
docs.faq4Q: What do the credit categories (A-E) mean?
docs.faq4A: Category A is Excellent (lowest risk), B is Good, C is Fair, D is Poor, and E is High Risk (highest risk). The category is determined by multiple financial indicators and AI analysis.
docs.faq5Q: How can I change my password?
docs.faq5A: Go to Profile → Security section. Enter your current password and new password, then click Save Changes.
docs.faq6Q: What if I encounter an error during upload?
docs.faq6A: Ensure your file is not corrupted and contains valid financial data. If the problem persists, contact support with the error message details.
docs.needHelpDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is ready to assist you.
